title: EX Champion Revali's Song

{{Hatnote|This article is about the Main Quest in {{BotW}}. For other uses, see [[Champion Revali's Song]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= [[File:BotW EX Champion Revali's Song.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |type= Main |game= BotW |giver= [[Monk|???]] |location= '''{{Color BotW|Main Quest|[[Strock Lake]]}}'''{{Note|Although the [[Adventure Log]] description denotes the location as the Strock Lake, the Quest is actually received on [[Cuho Mountain]].}} |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Revali's Gale +}} |previous= |next= }} "'''EX Champion Revali's Song'''" is a [[Main Quest]] in {{BotW}}. It is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|EX Champion Revali's Song||Series, BotW}} | {{BotW}} }} ==Overview== After finishing the trials on the [[Great Plateau]] during the "[[EX The Champions' Ballad]]" [[Main Quest]], the [[One-Hit Obliterator]] will split into four glowing orbs and scatter to different areas of [[Hyrule Kingdom]], revealing four ancient structures called [[Monument]]s. One of the Monuments appears near [[Strock Lake]] on [[Cuho Mountain]], south of [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]]. As [[Link]] approaches the Monument, a voice belonging to an unspecified [[Monk]] speaks to him and instructs him to complete the trials revealed to him.{{Cite|I applaud your courage in coming here. The locations that will be revealed to you are of trials that will enhance the power sleeping within. Do not let your guard down...|Monk|BotW}} Three maps then appear on the Monument's pillars, each revealing the location of a trial that Link must undergo. [[Kass]], who is standing nearby, makes a remark on either the Monument or the flash of light, depending on how many Monuments have already been visited.{{Cite|What was that...flash of light? Perhaps it was my imagination playing tricks on me.|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|Did that {{Color BotW|Blue|stone monument}} just start glowing? I suppose that proves I didn't imagine it the first time.|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|This {{Color BotW|Blue|stone monument}} has survived for 10,000 years. What secrets does it hold...|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|That light... Is it a reaction to someone nearby? Is it me...or is it...|Kass|BotW}} Though he did not initially notice Link,{{Cite|Hm? How long have you been here? I didn't even notice your arrival!|Kass|BotW}} Kass is still happy to see him again.{{Cite|Ah, we meet again! And it seems you caught me...well, talking to myself.|Kass|BotW}} He points out the Monument to Link, explaining that it was mentioned in his teacher's Unfinished Song.{{Cite|Look at that! There's one here too! One of the {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}} mentioned in my teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}}.|Kass|BotW}}{{Note|If this is the first Monument that Link has visited, Kass will explain that it was mentioned in an Unfinished Song written by his teacher.{{Cite|This {{Color BotW|Blue|monument}}... I must admit it has taken me by surprise! My teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}} mentions such {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}}, and now one has appeared before my eyes...|Kass|BotW}} At Link's confusion, Kass explains that it is missing its key verses.{{Cite|[Unfinished song?] Yes. The song is mostly complete. However... My teacher left this world without finishing the {{Color BotW|Blue|key verses}}.|Kass|BotW}} He is now on a journey to finish the song.{{Cite|I wish the weave the missing pieces together and finish the song.|Kass|BotW}}}} He thinks it is glorious that he is able to sing it in front of a Monument.{{Cite|Ah, sweet joy! How glorious to sing this song in front of the real {{Color BotW|Blue|monument}}...|Kass|BotW}} Kass adds that there is a verse in the song that mentions the trials that [[Revali]] overcame,{{Cite|The song my teacher left behind... There's {{Color BotW|Blue|a verse}} about the trials that {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Revali}} overcame.|Kass|BotW}} which he offers to sing it for Link,{{Cite|Allow me to sing it for you...|Kass|BotW}} The lyrics provide instructions for the three trials Link will need to face.{{Cite|♪Wind's ally soars the land of cloud.
{{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}}'s Champion, swift and proud.♪
♪The hero's power shall grow.
Seek trials {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}} show.♪
♪One, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot the flame dragon's horn}}.
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|race down a peak rings adorn}}.♪
♪Three, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot four targets to win}}.
Champion, the trials begin!♪|Kass|BotW}} When he is finished singing, Kass asks if Link was moved by his performance.{{Cite|...So? Did it move you?|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|...So? Did the {{Color BotW|Blue|verse}} move you? It was written in honor of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion}} challenging the trial.|Kass|BotW}} Learning about the [[Champion]]s in their homes have helped Kass with completing the song's key verses.{{Cite|By asking around about the {{Color BotW|Blue|Champions}} of each region, I'm starting to piece together the {{Color BotW|Blue|key verses}} of the song.|Kass|BotW}} He is inspired by the confidence it would take to master a [[Divine Beast]].{{Cite|The confidence it must have taken to master a {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast}}... How inspiring.|Kass|BotW}} The Unfinished Song weighs heavily on him, and so Kass has resolved to learn more about the Champions.{{Cite|My teacher's dream is now mine to fulfill. An {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}} weighs heavily on a bard's soul... I won't allow it. But in order to see this dream to fruition, I must learn more about the Champions of long ago...|Kass|BotW}} [[Teba]] and [[Kaneli]] have been helpful in Kass's search for knowledge,{{Cite|Thankfully, {{Color BotW|Blue|Teba}} and the {{Color BotW|Blue|Rito Village}} elder, {{Color BotW|Blue|Kaneli}}, told me some wonderful stories of the Rito Champion.|Kass|BotW}} but he still has much work to do on his journey.{{Cite|Yet this unfinished song still pulls at my heart. And so, my hometown is but a stopping point on this journey of mine.|Kass|BotW}} When he is finished speaking, the Main Quest will begin. Link may complete the trials in any order. The first trial tasks Link with shooting [[Dinraal]]'s horn as it flies over [[Tanagar Canyon]], revealing [[Shira Gomar Shrine]] on [[Upland Lindor]]. The second trial involves [[Shield Surfing]] through the [[Glowing Ring]]s starting near [[Hebra Peak]] and leading down to the [[Pikida Stonegrove]]. When Link passes through the final Glowing Ring, [[Kiah Toza Shrine]] will be unearthed. The third trial has Link shoot four targets in quick succession at the [[Flight Range]], which causes [[Noe Rajee Shrine]] to rise up at the bottom of the chasm. Each of these [[Ancient Shrine]]s rewards Link with one of [[Medoh's Emblem]]s upon their completion.{{Cite|Your resourcefulness in overcoming this trial speaks to the promise of a hero. In the name of the Goddess Hylia, I bestow upon you this gift... Medoh's Embelm.|Monk|BotW}} The Monk of the Shrine informs Link that collecting all three Emblems will unlock a new trial.{{Cite|Collect three emblems to open the path to a new challenge.|Monk|BotW}} They will then tell him how many Emblems he still has to collect.{{Cite|Two remain...|Monk|BotW}}{{Cite|One remains...|Monk|BotW}} After completing all three Ancient Shrines, the third Monk will instruct Link to go to Divine Beast Vah Medoh.{{Cite|Now that you have collected three emblems, you must go to Divine Beast Vah Medoh...|Monk|BotW}} As Link approaches the Divine Beast, he is spoken to again by an unspecified Monk, who gives him a trial in exchange for the three Emblems.{{Cite|To the one who approaches this Divine Beast... In the name of the Goddess Hylia, I offer this trial. In exchange for Medoh's Emblems... you will be granted the chance to tread through the realm of memories. Those who lack determination will find this trial unforgiving.|Monk|BotW}} The Monk warns Link not to dismiss it as only a world in his mind, as there is a deeper truth.{{Cite|Do not take this place lightly nor dismiss it as merely a world within your mind. The truth is much deeper than you know.|Monk|BotW}} Link is then transported to the [[Illusory Realm]], a realm created by his memories, where he must face a version of [[Windblight Ganon]] made from his own fear.{{Cite|This illusory realm was created from the depths of your memories... The enemy you shall face is a product of the fear that dwells within. This battle is a trial of the soul. You must emerge victorious using only the tools provided.|Monk|BotW}} Link's equipment, [[Armor]], and [[Inventory]] will be changed to the following: * [[Snowquill Set]] (upgraded twice) * [[Feathered Edge]] * [[Falcon Bow]] * [[Duplex Bow]] * [[Phrenic Bow]] * 100 [[Arrow]]s * Five [[Bomb Arrow]]s * [[Wildberry]] * [[Endura Shroom]] * [[Raw Bird Drumstick]] After defeating the phantasm, Link is transported back and finds Kass nearby. He believes that meeting Link in this location was not a coincidence,{{Cite|Perhaps meeting you here was no coincidence.|Kass|BotW}} as he considers it a perfect place to get lost in thought and write songs.{{Cite|This is a perfect spot for you to get lost in your thoughts, as well as a perfect spot for me to write a song.|Kass|BotW}} Learning about Revali has inspired Kass to write a song to honor the [[Rito]] Champion in his own way.{{Cite|Ah! Wandering around here and listening to anecdotes about {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Revali}} has truly invigorated me. In fact, it has inspired me to honor him in my own way, separate from my teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}}. That is why I felt inclined to roost here, near the {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Medoh}}, which {{Color BotW|Blue|Revali}} himself mastered. I've written a song...to try and capture the essence of {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Revali}}...|Kass|BotW}} He sings [[Champion Revali's Song (Song)|Champion Revali's Song]] to Link,{{Cite|♪Recall {{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}}'s Champion of flight,
before he fell to his fateful plight.♪
♪{{Color BotW|Blue|Revali}}'s feat was a wonder to see,
so the princess made her plea.♪|Kass|BotW}} which allows him to visualize the "[[Champion Revali's Song (Memory)|Champion Revali's Song]]" [[Recovered Memory]] from 100 years ago.{{Cite|Kass's composition, entitled {{Color BotW|Red|Champion Revali's Song}}, was so true and moving that it allowed you to visualize a memory from 100 years ago.|Adventure Log|BotW}} After the Memory, Kass notes that Revali did not like sharing his feelings with others.{{Cite|Hmm... It seems the {{Color BotW|Blue|Rito Champion}} was not one to share his feelings.|Kass|BotW}} He asks Link what he thought of the Song,{{Cite|So? What did you think of {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Revali's Song}}?|Kass|BotW}} explaining that writing it has helped him feel closer to his teacher.{{Cite|By writing a song that highlights the hidden feelings of Champion Revali, I feel closer than ever to my dear teacher.|Kass|BotW}} Kass feels confident that he will be able to finish the key verses of the Unfinished Song.{{Cite|I feel much more confident that I can do those missing lyrics justice.|Kass|BotW}} Revali then speaks to Link and expresses his shock that he was able to complete the trials, and by doing so, he will be able to use [[Revali's Gale]] more often.{{Cite|I truly never imagined you would do so well. Regardless, Revali's Gale should be more efficient than ever.|Revali|BotW}} The ability is upgraded to [[Revali's Gale +]], which reduces its recharge time to two minutes. As he is, Revali believes that Link could theoretically defeat [[Calamity Ganon]].{{Cite|As you are, I guess it's theoretically possible for you to best Ganon.|Revali|BotW}} After this, the Main Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | The scattered One-Hit Obliterator led you to a location where a stone monument with a map of trials appeared. Kass's song seems related...

One, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot the flame dragon's horn}},
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|race down a peak rings adorn}},
Three, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot four targets to win}},
Champion, the trials begin!

You still have {{Color BotW|Red|three}} trials to complete. |- | 2 | The scattered One-Hit Obliterator led you to a location where a stone monument with a map of trials appeared. Kass's song seems related...

One, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot the flame dragon's horn}},
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|race down a peak rings adorn}},
Three, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot four targets to win}},
Champion, the trials begin!

You still have {{Color BotW|Red|two}} trials to complete. |- | 3 | The scattered One-Hit Obliterator led you to a location where a stone monument with a map of trials appeared. Kass's song seems related...

One, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot the flame dragon's horn}},
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|race down a peak rings adorn}},
Three, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot four targets to win}},
Champion, the trials begin!

You still have {{Color BotW|Red|one}} trial to complete. |- | 4 | You completed the three trials inscribed on the stone monument in the Hebra region.

After you collected three of Medoh's Emblems, the monk told you to head to the Divine Beast. What awaits you there?

Go to the Divine Beast Vah Medoh to find out. |- | Complete | You defeated the phantasm of Windblight Ganon, which was born from your own memories and fears.

Kass's composition, entitled {{Color BotW|Red|Champion Revali's Song}}, was so true and moving that it allowed you to visualize a memory from 100 years ago.

By conquering the trial, your sacred power has increased and Revali's Gale has become more efficient than ever. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cuho Mountain * EX Champion Daruk's Song * EX Champion Mipha's Song * EX Champion Urbosa's Song * EX The Champions' Ballad * Monument * Strock Lake }} {{Notes}} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|EX Champion Revali's Song}}
